messages.content: The Hampton duplicate night is gone. I need the Chicago file reconciled before I send it for reimbursement approval. Can you check dates, venues, names, and receipts together?
Yes. Send me the identifying details as they appear on the flight, both hotels, and the registration documents, plus the workshop location.

United says PRIYA KAVITA NAIR. Hampton and Hyatt say Priya Nair. The main conference receipt also says Priya Nair, but the workshop registration says Priya K. Nair. My ID is Priya Kavita Nair. The conference is at Hyatt Regency Chicago; the Sunday workshop confirmation says UIC College of Pharmacy, 833 South Wood Street.

The travel dates now align: United to Chicago Saturday, August 17; Hampton for August 17 only, checking out August 18; Hyatt August 18-21; return Wednesday, August 21. The workshop is not at the Hyatt, so Sunday requires a separate transfer to UIC. What time does it begin, and do you have a revised Hampton receipt showing the removed night?
Workshop check-in is 12:30 p.m. I have an email confirming the August 18 checkout and a $214 refund, but the original prepaid receipt still shows August 17-19.

Include both Hampton documents and label the email as the adjustment record; the pair accounts for the original charge and $214 refund. For the names, the United ticket matches your ID. The abbreviated hotel and conference names are identifiable, but the workshop's middle initial creates another variation. For a clean submission, ask the conference organizer to reissue both registration receipts as Priya Kavita Nair, and ask each hotel for a folio under that same name if their systems permit.
Build the final summary. Include the venue transfer and tell me exactly what should be attached.

Chicago Quality Systems Conference, August 17-21. Fly United SFO-ORD Saturday, August 17, under PRIYA KAVITA NAIR. Stay at the Hampton the night of August 17 and check out August 18; attach the original prepaid receipt, the date-change email, and proof of the $214 refund. On Sunday, leave luggage with the Hyatt, then travel separately to UIC College of Pharmacy, 833 S. Wood St., for 12:30 p.m. workshop check-in. The main conference and August 18-21 stay are at Hyatt Regency Chicago. Return on United Wednesday, August 21. Attach the United confirmation and receipt, Hampton documents, Hyatt confirmation or folio, main conference receipt, workshop receipt, and any ground-transfer receipts. Before submission, obtain corrected registration receipts and, if available, corrected hotel folios in the full ID name. The itinerary itself has no remaining date conflict; the open items are document-name consistency and recording the Sunday Hyatt-to-UIC transfer.
